integrity: The open primary PDF was inspected at the theoretical LINEX estimator, the MCMC algorithm, the printed Monte Carlo LINEX approximation, the simulation choice of asymmetry parameter, and Table 1. Independent LINEX literature was checked for the posterior-expectation convention. The sign contradiction is algebraic, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the printed Monte Carlo LINEX formula and does not establish which expression was used in unavailable implementation code.
The full simulation and real-data Bayesian tables are not recomputed.
The direct negativity consequence is stated for positive LINEX asymmetry and positive target quantities, including the main simulation setting used by the source.
title: The published MCMC LINEX formula has the exponent sign reversed
